Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameActions
public class Game extends Object implements GameActions
Core game model implementing all game-flow logic for a single match of Mesos.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintains the authoritative game state (players, board, decks, turn order).
  • Implements GameActions: validates and applies all player actions.
  • Notifies registered GameObservers after every state change so that GameController can relay updates to clients.

    • restorePersistedState

      public void restorePersistedState(List<Player> restoredPlayers, String playerInTurnNick, List<String> roundOrderNicks, GameState state, Age age, int numPlayers, List<TribeCard> deckI, List<TribeCard> deckII, List<TribeCard> deckIII, List<EventCard> finalEvts, List<BuildingCard> buildings, int topPicks, int bottomPicks, List<TribeCard> boardTopTribe, List<TribeCard> boardBottomTribe, List<BuildingCard> boardTopBuild, List<BuildingCard> boardBottomBuild, Map<Character, String> spaceTotemColors, int turnOrderTag, List<String> blockTotemColors)
      Rebuilds the internal state of this Game from a previously saved snapshot. Called exactly once by PersistenceManager.restore() immediately after creating the Game with new Game(gameId).

      Does not touch mainDeck (used as a card catalogue for lookups) or observers. Non-final lists and references are set directly.

      Parameters:
      restoredPlayers - players already rebuilt with their cards and flags
      playerInTurnNick - nickname of the current player, or null if none
      roundOrderNicks - current round order as a list of nicknames
      state - game state to restore
      age - current era
      numPlayers - number of players
      deckI - remaining Era I tribe cards
      deckII - remaining Era II tribe cards
      deckIII - remaining Era III tribe cards
      finalEvts - remaining final event cards
      buildings - building cards in the game
      topPicks - current top-row pick counter
      bottomPicks - current bottom-row pick counter
      boardTopTribe - top tribe card row of the board
      boardBottomTribe - bottom tribe card row of the board
      boardTopBuild - top building card row of the board
      boardBottomBuild - bottom building card row of the board
      spaceTotemColors - map from space letter to TotemColor name (null means empty)
      turnOrderTag - configuration tag for TurnOrder
      blockTotemColors - totem color for each order block (null means empty)
